design: A occupies the back-left wing. B occupies the far rear corner: wide scrap workshop below, house over only its right half, open utility terrace to the left. C is on the right wing, with a squat recovered compressor-and-power-coupler frame BESIDE its inward end, staying in the perimeter strip. Left exit: open ground-level gap near the left end of the rear-left wall, with visible continuous paving into a narrow outward alley; no door swing, no overhead obstruction. Right exit: open ground-level gap near the right end of the rear-right wall beyond C, continuous outward paving and no obstruction. Both are clear from the center and bounded at their sides. Other rear gaps are closed solid boundary. Front cutaway: a shallow coarse masonry service foundation with one horizontal insulated coolant main on the left face, a sealed chunky power junction and cable tray on the right, solid sharp structural corners and no walkable tunnel.
